criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.transform.transform_items(mapping, *, key_fn=None, value_fn=None). Transform each original key/value exactly once into a new same-type ordered relation, validate both transformed key and value uniqueness before constructing/publishing, and report one-based conflicting source positions rather than silently dropping rows. Preserve inputs, inverse behavior, frozen/custom subclasses, callback exception identity and natural unhashable errors.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
